name: job
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname = 'stale_watch_10min'

name: checks
sql: select id, fired_at, status_code, built_at, error from stale_watch.checks order by fired_at desc limit 6

name: messages
sql: select id, episode, kind, delivery, created_at from stale_watch.messages order by id desc limit 6
